sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Aid Stations is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good afternoon, young man. Tarkov has endured a humanitarian crisis for far too many years. I'm sure you understand that civilians need places where they can shelter from both Scavs and mercenaries. I've done everything I can to help them, but lately that has become increasingly difficult. Could you obtain the keys to several locations I have identified? My people will be able to establish safe havens there for those in need."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Obtain 1 Dorm room 303 key
- Obtain 1 ZB-014 key
- Obtain 1 Military checkpoint key
- Obtain 1 Gas station storage room key
- Hand over 1 Dorm room 303 key
- Hand over 1 ZB-014 key
- Hand over 1 Customs military checkpoint key
- Hand over 1 Gas station storage room key

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Therapist Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Wonderful! Happy to work with you again, you have gained my trust once more."
